facts.text: The product is the Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress.
The selected variant is Queen | 78 x 60 (198 cm x 152 cm) | 8 (20.3 cm).
The selected variant’s listed dimensions are 198 cm long, 152 cm wide, and 20.3 cm high.
The product title specifies a combination of Airknit fibres and latex.

Airboost is described as Duroflex’s proprietary open-matrix mattress technology, made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres and designed to improve airflow, movement response, and postural support.
The mattress features a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex.
The reversible latex topper has firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other.
Flip the mattress to switch between the firmness levels.
The zipper cover can be removed and helps identify each side.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings are recommended to increase durability.
The Airboost 6.8 is described as having Arctic Ice cooling fabric and an open-cell 3D matrix.
The Duo Comfort flippable topper has Airboost Lite on one side for firm, adaptive support and Neo-Latex on the other for medium-firm, responsive comfort.
The title states a 100-nights trial, but that duration is unverified because another page passage describes a 100-day trial.
A product passage describes a 100-day sleep trial; the duration is unverified because the title states 100 nights.
The product page displays a 10-year warranty claim; the duration is unverified because the general warranty passage gives a variant-dependent 7–10-year range.

The general Airboost warranty description says coverage applies to manufacturing defects and material issues under normal use; it gives a 7–10-year duration depending on variant, which is not confirmed for this selected variant.
